title: Backstop Plan Schema v1
description: Schema for implementation plans with agent-bounded tasks (D-080) and file exclusivity enforcement (D-081). Extends backstop-artifact-base-v1.

number.description: Plan identifier, typically PLAN-SPEC-NNN or PLAN-ISSUE-NNN

phases.description: Ordered execution phases containing agent-bounded tasks

enforcement.D-080: Every task must be agent-bounded: non-empty files, description, claims, and explicit depends_on
enforcement.D-081: Parallel-eligible tasks (no transitive dependency) must have disjoint file sets
